nodes.name: ready-stories.ts
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env node /** * ready-stories.ts * * Lists stories that are ready to be worked on in parallel. * * A story is ready when: * 1. Its dependencies are completed * 2. Its touches don't overlap with in-progress stories * 3. No more than 2 stories are in progress * 4. No more than 1 story with migrations is in progress * * Usage: * pnpm ready:stories */ import * as fs from 'fs'; import * as path from 'path'; const EPICS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'specs', 'epics'); const EXECUTION_STATUS = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'specs', 'execution-status.yaml'); main();

nodes.name: Story
nodes.body_text: interface Story { id: string; title: string; touches: string[]; dependsOn: string[]; migrations: boolean; status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'; }

nodes.name: parseStoryFile
nodes.body_text: function parseStoryFile(filePath: string): Story | null { try { const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8'); const lines = content.split('\n'); const title = lines.find((l) => l.startsWith('# '))?.replace('# ', '') || ''; const id = path.basename(filePath, '.md'); // Parse touches, depends_on, migrations from YAML frontmatter or content const touches: string[] = []; const dependsOn: string[] = []; let migrations = false; // Simple parsing - in production, use a YAML parser for (const line of lines) { if (line.includes('touches:')) { const match = line.match(/touches:\s*\[(.*?)\]/); if (match) { touches.push(...match[1].split(',').map((s) => s.trim())); } } if (line.includes('depends_on:')) { const match = line.match(/depends_on:\s*\[(.*?)\]/); if (match) { dependsOn.push(...match[1].split(',').map((s) => s.trim())); } } if (line.includes('migrations:')) { migrations = line.includes('true'); } } return { id, title, touches, dependsOn, migrations, status: 'pending', }; } catch (error) { console.error(`Error parsing ${filePath}:`, error); return null; } }

nodes.name: getStories
nodes.body_text: function getStories(): Story[] { if (!fs.existsSync(EPICS_DIR)) { console.log('No epics directory found'); return []; } const files = fs.readdirSync(EPICS_DIR).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.md') && f.startsWith('e')); return files .map((f) => parseStoryFile(path.join(EPICS_DIR, f))) .filter((s): s is Story => s !== null); }

nodes.name: getExecutionStatus
nodes.body_text: function getExecutionStatus(): Record<string, string> { if (!fs.existsSync(EXECUTION_STATUS)) { return {}; } const content = fs.readFileSync(EXECUTION_STATUS, 'utf-8'); const status: Record<string, string> = {}; // Simple parsing - in production, use a YAML parser for (const line of content.split('\n')) { const match = line.match(/^(\w+):\s*(\w+)$/); if (match) { status[match[1]] = match[2]; } } return status; }

nodes.name: isReady
nodes.signature: function isReady(story: Story, allStories: Story[], status: Record<string, string>): boolean
nodes.body_text: function isReady(story: Story, allStories: Story[], status: Record<string, string>): boolean { // Check if already completed if (status[story.id] === 'completed') { return false; } // Check if dependencies are completed for (const dep of story.dependsOn) { if (status[dep] !== 'completed') { return false; } } return true; }

nodes.name: getReadyStories
nodes.body_text: function getReadyStories() { const stories = getStories(); const status = getExecutionStatus(); const inProgress = stories.filter((s) => status[s.id] === 'in_progress'); const ready = stories.filter((s) => isReady(s, stories, status)); // Filter out stories that overlap with in-progress stories const available = ready.filter((story) => { // Check WIP limit if (inProgress.length >= 2) { return false; } // Check migration limit if (story.migrations && inProgress.some((s) => s.migrations)) { return false; } // Check touches overlap for (const inProgressStory of inProgress) { const overlap = story.touches.some((t) => inProgressStory.touches.includes(t)); if (overlap) { return false; } } return true; }); return { ready: available, inProgress, blocked: stories.filter((s) => !isReady(s, stories, status) && status[s.id] !== 'completed'), }; }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: function main() { const { ready, inProgress, blocked } = getReadyStories(); console.log('Ready Stories:'); if (ready.length === 0) { console.log(' (none)'); } else { for (const story of ready) { console.log(` - ${story.id}: ${story.title}`); if (story.touches.length > 0) { console.log(` Touches: ${story.touches.join(', ')}`); } if (story.migrations) { console.log(` Has migrations`); } } } console.log('\nIn Progress:'); if (inProgress.length === 0) { console.log(' (none)'); } else { for (const story of inProgress) { console.log(` - ${story.id}: ${story.title}`); } } console.log('\nBlocked:'); if (blocked.length === 0) { console.log(' (none)'); } else { for (const story of blocked) { console.log(` - ${story.id}: ${story.title}`); console.log(` Dependencies: ${story.dependsOn.join(', ') || 'none'}`); } } }

nodes.name: sync-issues.ts
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env node /** * sync-issues.ts * * Synchronizes stories from specs/epics/ to GitHub Issues. * * Usage: * pnpm sync:issues [--dry-run] * * This script: * 1. Reads story files from specs/epics/ * 2. Creates or updates GitHub Issues * 3. Links issues to the GitHub Project */ import * as fs from 'fs'; import * as path from 'path'; const EPICS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'specs', 'epics'); const DRY_RUN = process.argv.includes('--dry-run'); syncIssues().catch(console.error);

nodes.name: Story
nodes.body_text: interface Story { id: string; title: string; description: string; acceptanceCriteria: string[]; labels: string[]; milestone?: string; }

nodes.name: parseStoryFile
nodes.body_text: function parseStoryFile(filePath: string): Story | null { try { const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8'); const lines = content.split('\n'); // Simple parser - in production, use a YAML parser const title = lines.find((l) => l.startsWith('# '))?.replace('# ', '') || ''; const id = path.basename(filePath, '.md'); return { id, title, description: content, acceptanceCriteria: [], labels: ['story'], }; } catch (error) { console.error(`Error parsing ${filePath}:`, error); return null; } }

nodes.name: getStories
nodes.body_text: function getStories(): Story[] { if (!fs.existsSync(EPICS_DIR)) { console.log('No epics directory found'); return []; } const files = fs.readdirSync(EPICS_DIR).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.md') && f.startsWith('e')); return files .map((f) => parseStoryFile(path.join(EPICS_DIR, f))) .filter((s): s is Story => s !== null); }

nodes.name: syncIssues
nodes.body_text: async function syncIssues() { console.log('Syncing issues...'); if (DRY_RUN) { console.log('DRY RUN - no changes will be made'); } const stories = getStories(); console.log(`Found ${stories.length} stories`); for (const story of stories) { console.log(`- ${story.id}: ${story.title}`); if (!DRY_RUN) { // TODO: Create or update GitHub Issue // This requires GitHub API authentication console.log(` Would create/update issue: ${story.title}`); } } console.log('Sync complete'); }
